question.en: Why is the new house special?
question.zh: 为什么这栋新房子很特别？

sentences.en: Why is the new house special?
sentences.zh: 为什么这栋新房子很特别？

sentences.en: I had a letter from my sister yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天我收到了姐姐的一封信。

sentences.en: In her letter, she said that she would come to England next year.
sentences.zh: 在信中她说她明年将到英国来。

chunks.x: that she would come to England next year

sentences.en: If she comes, she will get a surprise.
sentences.zh: 如果她来了，她会感到非常惊喜。

sentences.en: We are now living in a beautiful new house in the country.
sentences.zh: 我们现在住在乡间的一栋漂亮的新房子里。

chunks.x: in a beautiful new house in the country

sentences.en: Work on it had begun before my sister left.
sentences.zh: 这栋房子在我姐姐离开之前就已动工了。

sentences.en: The house was completed five months ago.
sentences.zh: 房子是在5个月以前竣工的。

sentences.en: In my letter, I told her that she could stay with us.
sentences.zh: 我在信中告诉她，她可以和我们住在一起。

sentences.en: The house has many large rooms and there is a lovely garden.
sentences.zh: 这栋房子里有许多房间，还有一个漂亮的花园。

sentences.en: It is a very modern house, so it looks strange to some people.
sentences.zh: 它是一栋非常现代化的住宅，因此在有些人看来很古怪。

chunks.x: It is a very modern house

sentences.en: It must be the only modern house in the district.
sentences.zh: 它肯定是这个地区唯一的一栋现代化住宅。
